stories.title: செய்திகள் சில வரிகளில்
takeaways: Boiler maintenance work commenced at the second unit of the North Chennai Expansion Thermal Power Station in Athipattu.
The routine technical work forms part of ongoing power generation upkeep in Thiruvallur district.
